Can't help but wanna try Chef Raymond Tan's new restaurant - Shinsho Ramen
Sep 2024 • Family
Since we really liked our experience enjoying Roka Fella's omakase, can't help but wanna try Chef Raymond Tan's new restaurant - Shinsho Ramen. 

Quite cool that they were able to re-create the Hakata (a region of Fuku-oka) Ramen - where Japanese Tonkotsu Ramen originated from. And like in Hakata and Kurume (another region famous for their ramen), Shinsho also makes the different firmness of ramen available - asking if you want your ramen more tender or firmer/more chewy.

Their pork broth was indeed rich and creamy, while their chasu was super tender after being in the sous-vide for numerous hours... But what I liked most was that they also innovated by creating new dishes such as Truffle Ramen - which seemed like a weird combination of flavours at first, and yet it was surprisingly good.

While friend was saying prices here were a little bit high for ramen - but those who know your ramen - you might not mind when the broth... and flavours, hit the spot.
